p1c1.caption: Three bars over a buried query — the slit
p1c1.content_rationale: Being is forgotten; three prejudices (most universal, indefinable, self-evident) declare the question superfluous. Average comprehensibility hides an enigma; the giants' battle of the Sophist must be rekindled. The chapter ends demanding a formulation.
p1c1.ending_cadence: Flecks thin to zero over the final third — the question falls silent, formulation still owed. Extra breather before #chapter-nav.

p1c1.title: The Necessity of an Explicit Repetition of the Question of Being

p1c2.caption: The loop that is not a circle
p1c2.content_rationale: Every questioning is a seeking with prior guidance: Gefragtes (asked about), Befragtes (interrogated), Erfragtes (to be found out). Dasein is named as the being to interrogate; the apparent circle is a backward-or-forward relatedness. Transparency, not viciousness.
p1c2.ending_cadence: Final fleck cluster forms an OPEN arc — the loop left unclosed. Transparency, not conclusion; normal nav spacing.

p1c2.title: The Formal Structure of the Question of Being

p1c3.caption: The plumb line through the crack
p1c3.content_rationale: Sciences stand on unexamined fundamental concepts; real movement is crisis in basic concepts — mathematics, relativity physics, biology, history. Ontology, the genealogy of ways of being, must precede and found the ontic sciences.
p1c3.ending_cadence: Last band lands as a single foundation course — the grounding the sciences lack. Firm close, standard breather.

p1c3.title: The Ontological Priority of the Question of Being

p1c4.caption: Three roots, one trunk
p1c4.content_rationale: Dasein defined: the being concerned about its being; existence (Existenz) versus existentia; existentiell versus existential understanding. Threefold priority (ontic, ontological, ontic-ontological); fundamental ontology is the existential analytic of Dasein.
p1c4.ending_cadence: Root-hair flecks converge toward one point — the analytic as root system found. Brief pause, then nav.

p1c4.title: The Ontic Priority of the Question of Being

p1c5.caption: Nearest below, farthest above
p1c5.content_rationale: Dasein is ontically nearest, ontologically farthest. The analytic must expose the horizon; temporality (Zeitlichkeit) is named as the meaning of Dasein's being. Time must be grasped as horizon, not as beings merely 'in time'.
p1c5.ending_cadence: Hatch gradient resolves to bare ground — distance reached, horizon exposed. Longest end-breather in the Introduction.

p1c6.caption: Tradition tilted −4°
p1c6.content_rationale: Tradition covers the wellsprings; destruction loosens the sclerotic tradition and returns positively to its three decisive stages — Kant, Descartes, Aristotle — along the guideline of temporality. Negative function tacit; positive intent.
p1c6.ending_cadence: Sediment bands settle flat and level — excavation backfilled, positive return complete. Calm close.

p1c7.caption: The point where light lands
p1c7.content_rationale: Phenomenon (what shows itself, phos-light) plus logos (letting be seen) yields the maxim 'To the things themselves!'. Appearing versus semblance; covering-up as concealment, submersion, dissimulation; being as the transcendens. The cohort's noon — longest chapter.
p1c7.ending_cadence: Veil rhythm resolves OPEN — last region parted, light lands, method established. The only Introduction ending with light still on the ground.

p2c1.ending_cadence: Even flecks simply STOP mid-measure — everydayness has no finale, it continues. No emphasis.
